headline: Tom Dreesen, Comic Who Kept Sinatra’s Crowds Laughing, Dies at 86
context: He rose from a hardscrabble childhood to form a pioneering interracial comedy duo. He later spent years opening for Frank Sinatra.

sources.name: The New York Times
